product_name: FC4028 中子周围剂量当量（率）仪
product_name_en: FC4028 Neutron Ambient Dose Equivalent (Rate) Meter
summary: 该中子剂量率仪为智能化辐射测量仪表，采用智能化探头，并通过连接多功能辐射测量主机即可使用。此仪表丰富了智能化探头系列，并扩展了多功能辐射测量仪的应用。仪表在统一的巡检系统软件平台、一台多功能辐射测量仪基础上实现了产品的系列化。客户通过选用不同的探头即可满足各种使用要求。该探头使用了3He正比计数管加聚乙烯慢化体，用于测量中子剂量率。本产品广泛用于核电站、核动力装置、研究型核反应堆、加速器及中子源操作等场所中的中子剂量率的检测，也可以用于各级环保局、疾病控制中心、石油测井等。符合标准：GB/T 14318-2019/IEC 61005:2014《辐射防护仪器中子周围剂量当量（率）仪》。
summary_en: This neutron dose rate meter is an intelligent radiation measurement instrument that uses a smart probe connected to a multi-functional radiation measurement host. This instrument enriches the smart probe series and expands the application of multi-functional radiation measurement instruments. The instrument achieves product serialization based on a unified inspection system software platform and one multi-functional radiation measurement instrument. Customers can meet various usage requirements by selecting different probes. The probe uses a 3He proportional counter tube plus polyethylene moderator for measuring neutron dose rate. This product is widely used for neutron dose rate detection in nuclear power plants, nuclear power installations, research nuclear reactors, accelerators, and neutron source operations, and can also be used by environmental protection bureaus at all levels, CDC, oil logging, etc. Compliant with standard: GB/T 14318-2019/IEC 61005:2014.
key_application: 应用领域：核设施、核监管及“涉源”企事业单位的辐射防护；石油勘探中子探测；探矿作业；环境监测部门执行公务、疾控卫生部门应急响应；大型活动、驻外使领馆的安全戒备；检验检疫、海关、口岸、边防等核与辐射反恐，防止非法放射性物质运输和放射性恐怖袭击等；第三方检测机构。
key_application_en: Radiation protection for nuclear facilities, nuclear supervision and source-related enterprises; oil exploration neutron detection; prospecting operations; environmental monitoring departments, CDC emergency response; security for major events and overseas embassies/consulates; nuclear and radiation counter-terrorism for customs, ports, and border defense to prevent illegal radioactive material transport; third-party testing institutions.
key_parameter_1: 中子探头探测器: 3He正比计数管+聚乙烯慢化体（球形）
key_parameter_1_en: Neutron Probe Detector: 3He Proportional Counter + Polyethylene Moderator (Spherical)

parameters.中子探头探测器: 3He 正比计数管+聚乙烯慢化体（球形）
parameters.耐辐照特性: γ射线累积剂量300Sv以内仪器可正常工作
parameters.报警类别: 阈值、过载、故障、电池欠压
parameters.角响应: 优秀的球形几何结构和计数管相对位置使仪器4π角度响应偏差小于±10%
parameters.耐腐蚀性: 可抗弱酸、弱碱及盐溶液；60℃以下不溶于大多数溶剂
parameters.供电: 整机由主机供电，主机内置充电锂电池
parameters.功耗: 整机耗电≤200mW（不含显示器背光耗电）
parameters.工作时间: 与主机共同使用，关闭蜂鸣器和背光灯状态下可持续工作24小时以上

parameters_en.Host Measurement Range: Absorbed dose rate: 10nGy/h - 100mGy/h, Dose equivalent rate: 10nSv/h - 100mSv/h
parameters_en.Radiation Resistance: Instrument operates normally within cumulative γ-ray dose of 300Sv
parameters_en.Alarm Categories: Threshold, overload, fault, battery low voltage
parameters_en.Display Units: nSv/h, nGy/h, μGy/h, μSv/h, cps, etc.
parameters_en.Angular Response: Excellent spherical geometry and counter tube position result in 4π angular response deviation less than ±10%
parameters_en.Corrosion Resistance: Resistant to weak acids, weak bases and salt solutions; insoluble in most solvents below 60℃
parameters_en.Power Supply: Entire unit powered by host, host has built-in rechargeable lithium battery
parameters_en.Operating Time: Over 24 hours continuous operation with host when buzzer and backlight are off

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 本仪器采用高灵敏的进口探测器，反应速度快。该仪器使用方便。
  • 灵敏度高、抗γ性能好、能量响应特性好。
  • 即可用作便携式仪器又可用作固定式中子剂量监测仪，可以外接各种专业辐射计量探头，并且可与上位机联机配合分析软件进行专业分析。
  • 独立的伽玛、中子测量通道和报警提示。
  • 报警阈值连续可调，声光提示报警。
detail_html_en:
Features

  • The instrument uses high-sensitivity imported detectors with fast response speed. The instrument is convenient to use.
  • High sensitivity, good anti-γ performance, and good energy response characteristics.
  • Can be used as both a portable instrument and a fixed neutron dose monitor, can be connected to various professional radiation measurement probes, and can be linked to a host computer with analysis software for professional analysis.
  • Independent gamma and neutron measurement channels with alarm prompts.
  • Alarm thresholds are continuously adjustable, with audible and visual alarm prompts.
